pages.text: Store nine spell cores and cast the selected spell. Sneak-right-click to open its core inventory and transfer cores normally. Contents persist inside the wand.

pages.title: Casting and selection
pages.text: Right-click instant spells, hold and release charged spells, and hold continuous spells. Empty or unformed cores cannot cast.$(br2)Use L2ItemSelector keys to switch, normally Up/Down. The tooltip shows core count, current selection and cost multipliers.

pages.title: Mana and Focus
pages.text: Carry charged mana containers in your inventory or offhand; multiple containers combine automatically. Casting does not consume cores.$(br2)Focus recovers naturally. After overdraw, wait until it is full before casting again. Creative mode needs no resources. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
